```python
# Test cases for shlex_split(s)

# Basic whitespace splitting
assert shlex_split("ls -l") == ["ls", "-l"], (shlex_split("ls -l"), ["ls", "-l"])
assert shlex_split("   ls    -l   ") == ["ls", "-l"], (shlex_split("   ls    -l   "), ["ls", "-l"])
assert shlex_split("") == [], (shlex_split(""), [])

# Single quotes (literal, no escapes)
assert shlex_split("ls 'my file.txt'") == ["ls", "my file.txt"], (shlex_split("ls 'my file.txt'"), ["ls", "my file.txt"])
assert shlex_split("'quoted space'") == ["quoted space"], (shlex_split("'quoted space'"), ["quoted space"])
assert shlex_split("'it\\'s'") == ["it\\'s"], (shlex_split("'it\\'s'"), ["it\\'s"])

# Double quotes (backslash escapes only \ and ")
assert shlex_split('ls "my file.txt"') == ["ls", "my file.txt"], (shlex_split('ls "my file.txt"'), ["ls", "my file.txt"])
assert shlex_split('"escaped\\"quote"') == ['escaped"quote'], (shlex_split('"escaped\\"quote"'), ['escaped"quote'])
assert shlex_split('"escaped\\\\slash"') == ['escaped\\slash'], (shlex_split('"escaped\\\\slash"'), ['escaped\\slash'])
assert shlex_split('"literal\\nslash"') == ['literal\\nslash'], (shlex_split('"literal\\nslash"'), ['literal\\nslash'])

# Backslash escaping outside quotes
assert shlex_split(r"ls\ file.txt") == ["ls file.txt"], (shlex_split(r"ls\ file.txt"), ["ls file.txt"])
assert shlex_split(r"ls\ \ file.txt") == ["ls  file.txt"], (shlex_split(r"ls\ \ file.txt"), ["ls  file.txt"])

# Adjacent quoted and unquoted runs concatenating into ONE token
assert shlex_split("ls'file.txt'") == ["lsfile.txt"], (shlex_split("ls'file.txt'"), ["lsfile.txt"])
assert shlex_split('ls"file.txt"') == ["lsfile.txt"], (shlex_split('ls"file.txt"'), ["lsfile.txt"])
assert shlex_split("'part1'part2") == ["part1part2"], (shlex_split("'part1'part2"), ["part1part2"])
assert shlex_split('"part1"part2') == ['part1part2'], (shlex_split('"part1"part2'), ['part1part2'])
assert shlex_split("part1'part2'") == ["part1part2"], (shlex_split("part1'part2'"), ["part1part2"])

# Complex mixed cases
assert shlex_split(r"ls -l 'quoted space' \"double\\\"quote\" \ escaped\space") == ["ls", "-l", "quoted space", 'double"quote', " escapedspace"], (shlex_split(r"ls -l 'quoted space' \"double\\\"quote\" \ escaped\space"), ["ls", "-l", "quoted space", 'double"quote', " escapedspace"])
```
